auxiliary_files.note: World Bank country metadata used to retain only records where region.id != 'NA'. It is an auxiliary classification artefact, not a model observation source.

description: Immutable World Bank v2 JSON acquisition for the BERM global panel (eight indicators).

files.note: World Bank indicator SP.DYN.TFRT.IN (tfr); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation.
World Bank indicator SP.POP.TOTL (population); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation.
World Bank indicator SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS (urban_pct); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation.
World Bank indicator IT.CEL.SETS.P2 (mobile_per_100); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation. This is a proxy, not an RF dose.
World Bank indicator IT.NET.BBND.P2 (broadband_per_100); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation. This is a proxy, not an RF dose.
World Bank indicator IT.NET.USER.ZS (internet_pct); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation. This is a proxy, not an RF dose.
World Bank indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD (gdp_ppp_per_capita); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation.
World Bank indicator SP.DYN.CONU.ZS (contraception_pct); raw paginated JSON responses retained without value transformation.

retrieval_method: World Bank v2 JSON API, format=json, per_page=20000, all pages retained
